Ruling parties like Denmark’s Social Democrats have moved right on immigration to stymie the far-right’s progress, and the Swedish center-left’s victory last week — running on stricter migration rules — reflects that “ nativism is now shared by all [of Sweden’s] major parties, albeit in lighter form,” a political scientist told The Guardian. Facing a challenge from the right, Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni announced Sunday that Italy would ban face coverings in schools. — Brendan Ruberry

articles.summary: President Donald Trump’s latest assault on the news media came on Friday afternoon when he decreed on Truth Social that Politico , MS NOW, and CNN are now banned from the White House. Talking to reporters in the Oval Office, he said, “There’s something wrong with a country that can allow people to write purposely negative stories.” What a bizarre thing to say. Our country has tolerated the press writing “negative stories” more or less since its founding. It’s a freedom enshrined in our First Amendment. One might expect the president, who swore an oath to uphold the Constitution, to respect that. Read more
